title: Austin Airport & EMS Diversity Briefings
summary:
*   **Austin Airport & Mueller Redevelopment**: Major updates were discussed regarding the ongoing construction of Austin-Bergstrom International Airport, parking forecasts, and the redevelopment plans for the former Robert Mueller Airport site.
*   **Workforce Diversity in EMS**: A presentation focused on strategies to enhance workforce diversity within the city's Emergency Medical Services (EMS) department.
*   **City Performance Review**: Officials received a comprehensive year-end report detailing the performance across various city departments.
